Title: The Flight Before Christmas
Writer: Hannu Tuomainen, Marteinn Thorisson, Mark Hodkinson
Actors: Olli Jantunen, Hannu-Pekka Björkman, Vuokko Hovatta
Plot: A young reindeer who suffers from vertigo learns to overcome his fear, takes flying lessons from a clumsy flying squirrel and heads to the North pole to save a troubled Santa and his fleet of flying reindeer.
Country: Finland, Denmark, Germany, Ireland, United States
